topic_summary.description: Concise 1–2 sentence summary of the textbook topic and scope discussed (may mix 中文 and English in one string).

scope_and_constraints.description: Mathematical boundaries from the chat (e.g. addition within 20, no carrying). Single string only — do not split into separate language keys.

scope_feedback.description: Why the scope score was given and what is still missing (teacher-facing feedback).
